product_one_liner.value: Obsidian Security is a SaaS security platform for enterprise security teams that provides visibility across business apps and AI agents, detects threats, and enforces least-privilege access.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes complete SaaS security across business apps, while the company announcement explains that the platform gives security teams visibility, controls, and runtime context for AI and agent activity.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page that describes free pricing and modular plans.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company careers page explicitly identifies Snowflake and T-Mobile as enterprises that trust Obsidian. | named_customers.0: Snowflake is explicitly named as a company that trusts Obsidian. | named_customers.1: T-Mobile is explicitly named as a company that trusts Obsidian.

employee_band.notes: The cited headcount of 249 falls within the 201-500 employee band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement identifies Palo Alto as its headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as Palo Alto, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company careers page states that Obsidian Security was founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index displays a latest post by its SVP of Product and Corporate Marketing. The inspected blog includes one clearly technical post co-authored by an ML engineer and security researcher, but the evidence does not establish a second engineering-authored post about how the product is built, so it does not meet the stated two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The product documentation URLs return a session-expired page and instruct readers to open documentation through the authenticated Obsidian portal, so the material is not publicly accessible documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official live Greenhouse openings list includes AI Security Engineer, Agent Security Research Engineer, and Software Engineer - AI Security Product roles.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company Trust Center lists ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 among its certifications; the other items listed there are not among the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names SOC 2.
